info.title: Belong Universal API
info.description: Belong is a token-gated events, memberships, and venue engagement platform with APIs for events, hubs, notes, addresses, QR pass workflows, and on-chain collection flows.

get.description: Retrieves the current user profile from Belong.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

email.description: Primary email address for the authenticated user.

name.description: Structured name object returned by Belong.

proGaslessCollection.description: Whether gasless collection support is enabled for the user.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
